cohort: 124 children diagnosed with intellectual disability, aged 5 to 18 years, from Instituto Nacional de Salud del Nino.
finding: Intragenic variants were identified as the etiology in 30.6% of patients with intellectual disability, with MECP2, STXBP1, and LAMA2 being the most frequent genes.
cross-section timing: when participants were between 5 and 18 years old
